memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anaemia.
Patient presents with fatigue and pallor; mild conjunctival pallor noted, no hepatosplenomegaly. Labs show low Hb and ferritin. Sciatica also reported with right leg pain on straight leg raise.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD
pregabalin 75 mg BD
Diclofenac 50 mg BD after food
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 9.2 g/dL (13.0-17.0)
Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (30-400)
MCV 78 fL (80-100)

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Straight leg raise test: positive at 40 degrees on the right, suggestive of L5-S1 radiculopathy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Orthopaedic Spine Clinic for evaluation of lumbar radiculopathy likely secondary to disc protrusion.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-06-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anaemia improving.
Patient reports less fatigue; conjunctival pallor reduced. Sciatica pain unchanged. Examination: mild tenderness over lumbar spine, straight leg raise still positive at 45 degrees.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 11.5 g/dL (13.0-17.0)
Serum ferritin 28 ng/mL (30-400)
MCV 82 fL (80-100)

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days
pregabalin 75 mg BD
Diclofenac 50 mg BD after food
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anaemia resolved.
Patient asymptomatic; no pallor. Hb normal. Sciatica: right leg pain worsened, now radiating to foot; straight leg raise positive at 30 degrees.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 14.0 g/dL (13.0-17.0)
Serum ferritin 45 ng/mL (30-400)
MCV 88 fL (80-100)

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
ferrous sulfate stopped
pregabalin 75 mg BD
Diclofenac 50 mg BD after food
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Lumbar spine X-ray: mild degenerative changes at L4-L5, no overt fracture or malignancy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Orthopaedic Spine Clinic reports MRI lumbar spine shows a posterior disc protrusion at L4-L5 impinging the traversing L5 nerve root. Recommends epidural steroid injection and physiotherapy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine (L1-S1): posterior disc protrusion at L4-L5 measuring 6 mm, causing mild thecal sac compression and left L5 nerve root irritation.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: 'My leg pain is worse after long walks, I feel numbness in my foot. The pregabalin makes me drowsy in the morning.'

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed to earlier date: new slot 2026-04-05 at 09:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).
